meta.title: Bella Nails – Nail Salon in Ørestad, Copenhagen | Shellac, Gel & BIAB
meta.description: Bella Nails is an intimate nail salon in Ørestad by Bella Kvarter, Copenhagen. Gel extensions, classic manicure, Shellac and BIAB. Book online.

formula.headingAccent: even on the most difficult nails.
formula.body: Difficult nails are exactly why I do this. I've lived with thin, brittle nails myself — so I know how discouraging they are, and how good it feels when they finally hold. Every set I do is built on Didier Lab gel: HEMA-free, vegan, reinforced with invisible fiberglass and enriched with Vitamin E and calcium. Lasting strength that leaves your own nails better than I found them.

one.title: Private Sessions, Fully Yours
one.body: By appointment only, with the studio reserved for one client at a time.

two.title: Premium Formulas, Carefully Chosen
two.body: European gel systems selected for lasting wear, finish, and nail health.

three.title: Difficult Nails, Done Properly
three.body: Built with lasting quality even on difficult nails, backed by our studio guarantee.

one.quote: The most considered nail experience I have ever had. The silence alone is worth the price.
